issues.description: Original 1647 Wellcome scan is one historic printed witness only. No independent edition or manuscript was collated.
Claude CLI's weekly limit prevented the planned first independent reader; Codex CLI attempts failed transport or timed out, so zero independent image-first source reports exist for B02v.
Producer's manual source reading is editorial; original images are controlling. Source-read completeness and every glyph must not be certified solely by passing structural tests.
The house of the thief starts on PDF381 below a heading; B02u already accepted same physical PDF381 above the heading. Avoid duplicate units.

Image-first p347 review distinguishes the Sun (☉) location of thief's house from Moon (☽) door of that house; the earlier 'fortune-like glyph' producer gloss was corrected, with original bytes retained. PDF387/printed353 separately describes entry placement.
Original p351 distance worked example uses fixed sign four miles per sign plus degrees; it is not a measured journey or an independent person.
p351 place-of-goods sign and p352 hidden-place sign have similar but not identical descriptors (fixed in earth versus on earth; common eaves versus covered place). Keep printed variants.
p352 second and fourth rulers in one sign, and thief significator with fourth ruler, are different role comparisons. Do not substitute.
p352 Moon's TERM ruler, Moon's DOME ruler and Moon herself are three different source roles. Original term systems need source-specific computation.
p353 printed north/south-node glyphs under house-entry schema are small; glyph identity and whether signs are astronomical nodes require diplomatic verification.
p354 tenth-house planet door materials are not the same as p353 fourth-house planet interior-room placement.
p354 planetary goods lists and the next p354 quality-of-goods lists overlap but have different contents; original margin says second lord more proper in some settings.
p355 recovery-positive list is qualified by printed 'Signs of short ascensions'; individual table and body terms have not been empirically tested.
p355 has Moon in second square Sun in twelfth as a positive recovery example, counterintuitive against standard negative square-aspect doctrine; keep exact printed source.
p355 and p356 recovery definitions can conflict about whether the relevant planets being in angles makes recovery sooner, mean-time or difficult. Maintain local paragraph context.
p356 timing degrees to hours/days/weeks/years depends on source significator selection and signs. No independently verified 1647 ephemeris dates, no modern calendar inference.
p356 explicitly warns its stolen-goods timing method should NOT be used for other question categories.
p357 lord of eighth in first predicts recovery, whereas lord of second in eighth denies it. Direction/house role is essential.
p357 Sun/Moon below earth versus Sun/Moon together aspect ascendant have opposite declared meanings, without outcome testing.
p358 eighth-to-second light transfer can be positive, while lord of second applying to eighth lord is negative. Preserve apparent source contradiction.
p359 repeated thief-related return and offender-capture clauses include claims by Lilly of prior success, but no independently sampled denominators or external charts.

Original errata printed p360 line4 and PDF394 body both visually show Sun in conjunction; producer omitted conjunction from R2819, now corrected. Precise purpose of replacement erratum and remaining glyph alignment unresolved.
Original printed p360 signature headings Whether Thief shall be known, Owner suspects, and Who did deed are distinct claim targets, not confirmed person identities.
p361 house/family acquaintance and stranger classifications can contradict one another or use different luminary/house dignity levels. Do not retrospectively cherry-pick.
p362 Moon-quarter/oriental age methods, houses ×5 years and seventh degrees ×2 years are competing authorial estimates, not independently precise ages.
p363 historical alleged thief sex, fatness, leanness, stature and strength categories have no verified discriminatory or forensic validity and must not be used on actual people.
p363 'He remains' begins but may have an incomplete predicate/catchword before p364 next heading; no consequent invented.
p364 printed house-to-direction table and p365 two sign-to-direction tables may disagree. Original margin explicitly tolerates difference; do not choose result by known location.
Two p365 zodiacal direction tables are separated and source image preserved, 12 rows each; original sign glyphs need full diplomatic confirmation.
p365 swift, uncertain and slow flight alternative schemes partly overlap by planetary station/short-long ascensions. Do not impose universal numerical speed.
p365-366 'He shall be taken' combinations are historically alleged offender-capture rules only; no real culprit/flight tracking.
p366 'not taken' Fortune in third/eleventh attributes help to strangers/friends; these are purported actor roles not observed conspirators.
p366 'Goods restored' conflicts with earlier 2nd/8th house negative predictions. Preserve same planetary-actor direction and clause scope.
p366 'No Restitution' unclear grouping of Sun/Moon not aspecting and Part-of-Fortune-like glyph/both below earth. No operator silently fixed.

Original p365 and p366 both offer capture lists but with materially distinct conditions. Producer p365 accidentally reused p366 Moon/aspect conditions; corrected p365 to its own printed clauses. Repeat counts must be limited to genuine literal duplicates after source review.
p366 Chapter LI battle begins below divider. None of its battle/chart conditions are in this batch.

Lilly’s descriptive rules about thieves, guilt, stolen objects, suspects, sex, age and household relationships are historical claims only; not current legal, medical, ethical or law-enforcement advice.
Printed House/Sign direction tables have a finite 12-row source transcription for each but their completeness is not certified by an independent reviewer or corrected for all printer errata.
No 1647 historical worked chart in this source window has been compared with independently verified theft outcomes; one p352 reported bed/robe case is author reported only.
A 402-unit normalized source text inventory is a documentation count, not 402 independent persons, outcomes, experiments or successful astrological forecasts.
Only originally stated conditions should be applied; several clauses use or/and in dense print, so source parsing and polarity must be independently inspected before admission.
Retained Ptolemy baseline 1066, accepted Lilly 2572; proposed candidate combined 4040 is NOT accepted until source-fidelity review and canonical Git receipts.
Some earlier source draft records had their source kind, statement and page-crossing fields shifted. Five were repaired with exact original draft backed up and a regression is needed.
Original marginal handwritten readings on page images (numbering by later hand) are not automatically printed 1647 words. Keep separate provenance.
Historical room/animal/cattle analogies may conflict within different printed methods; preserving source contradiction is preferable to fabricating a unified deterministic algorithm.

PDF394/printed360 says ascendant lord in second, 'sixt' (sixth), or seventh, not FIRST; earlier R2832 producer paraphrase corrected and original source preserved. This is historical text, not an offender inference.

Original PDF392/printed358 says first lord applies to 'the second' OR second lord to 'the Ascendant'. Producer assumed these were aspects between first and second house lords; replaced with literal source-object wording and retained cusp-versus-lord ambiguity.
Original PDF395/printed361 first-offence rule prints Part of Fortune ⊗, not generic 'a Fortune'. Corrected R2848 source identity with original source bytes preserved. No empirical validation.

PDF396/printed362 prints 'consider most of these wayes, and pitch upon the greatest number' in age methods. Producer interpreted greatest amount of agreeing testimony, not explicitly in source. Corrected R2873 to source-literal reading; whether numerically greatest estimate or consensus intended remains uncertain.

Original PDF399/printed365 capture paragraph was replaced in the producer extraction by conditions belonging to PDF400/printed366, duplicating next-page content and missing its distinct Moon L7→L1 application, Sun/Moon Lord7 conjunction, combustion, and angular clauses. Six relevant draft source kinds/statements corrected from original p365 image, including R2940–R2945; unqualified p365-vs-p366 'repetition' is not established.
Original PDF388/printed354 says 'as a Furnace or Querne' under Moon in tenth; earlier R2699 producer paraphrase substituted 'oven'. Corrected to quern/grain mill, with before-edit bytes frozen.

Original PDF392/printed358 places both eventual difficult recovery and the separate alleged plurality of actors in one angular mutual-luminary-aspect condition; the following trine specifically eases recovery. The prior editorial paragraph attached plurality only to the trine record. Corrected R2772 and R2773 without treating either assertion as validated.

Original PDF394/printed360 'Who did the Deed or Theft': Sun OR Moon 'in the sixt, a Servant'. Former draft R2835 erroneously identified first/ascendant; corrected to SIXTH, with before-edit producer JSON preserved. Historical allegation only.

PDF386/printed352 and PDF387/printed353 worked lost-object report is explicitly attributed to HALY, with LEO ascending and VENUS in ascendant. P385C041/P385C042 (provisional R2674–R2675) previously misattributed to Lilly and read Leo as Libra; corrected both editorial records and froze prior producer bytes. No independent case authentication.

Original Lilly PDF400/printed366 last capture rule immediately above Chapter LI says Moon in eighth in OPPOSITION ☍ to Mars in second, NOT conjunction. Corrected R2973 / P398C072; removed spurious geometry-inconsistency gloss, froze original source bytes.
PDF391/357 R2762 originally says bodily application yields recovery itself, with subsequent retrograde/direct timing. Producer recorded only timing; both meanings restored.
PDF397/363 R2895 says 'the Significators' in plural crossing zodiac sign, not a singular thief significator; threshold remains unstated.
PDF397/363 R2901 'and behold the ascendant' has no certain actor; previous producer assigned cadent planet alone, now source ambiguity explicit.
